status: inventory only; no text admission, model scoring or split allocation
source: Existing PLOS JATS captures from acquisition-v1
count_method: Inspect all cached journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file responses; verify cached body hashes and the DOI against the request.
Compare canonical DOI source groups against the frozen historical work index and all V6 fresh human roots.
Inspect top-level sections marked intro or titled Introduction/Background. Keep separate sections separate; count paragraph projections with the recorded container exclusions.

Additional counts use the saved article/section metadata: english, research_article, publication_year=2019, has_explicit_cc_by_link; quotation flag; any inline-formula/disp-formula/math/tex-math; any xref. These flags are not admission decisions.

validation.extraction_case: Keeps sections separate, retains citation text, records excluded figure markup and included quotation markup, and rejects a mismatched DOI.

limitations: The candidate counts do not establish commercial admission or permission for every incorporated passage. Item-level rights, quotations and notices still require review.
Current JATS content with a 2019 publication date has not been matched to an immutable historical byte version.
Whitespace words are not A-tokenizer counts. No claim about support within A's context limit follows.
Paragraph projection is diagnostic: figure/table/footnote/supplement containers are excluded and their markup remains flagged. It is not an approved complete-text extraction.
Absence from the exclusion inputs does not imply absence from foundation-model pretraining.
Canonical DOI exclusion does not complete related-work, exact-text or normalized-text duplicate screening.
No human-only workflow, model sensitivity, style independence, Pangram agreement or detector improvement is established.
next_action: Review exact section content, historical evidence, item rights and citation/markup rendering before declaring a new source-admission and matched-generation protocol.
